name: Hallowed Sigil
summary: In Shadowglen, the Hallowed Sigil calls young night elf initiates to Aldrassil. Shanda sends it to summon them into service to Elune.

sections.title: A Summons to the Priesthood
sections.body: Young night elf priests in Shadowglen receive the Hallowed Sigil from a woodland messenger. Holy markings cover the token, which bears a personal summons from Shanda, the priest trainer at Aldrassil. Read the message, then climb to Aldrassil’s great hollow. There, the summons brings the acolyte to the Sisterhood of Elune and begins their service to the Kaldorei as new travelers arrive across Teldrassil.

faq.answer: Young night elf priests in Shadowglen receive the Hallowed Sigil, a holy token bearing a summons. It tells the initiate to seek Shanda, their mentor.
A woodland messenger carries the Hallowed Sigil for Shanda, the priest trainer inside Aldrassil.

faq.q: Where should I take the sigil?
aliases: where do i bring hallowed sigil
faq.answer: Take the sigil to Shanda inside Aldrassil, at the heart of Shadowglen in Teldrassil. Read the summons, then present the token to her for your first introduction to your priesthood mentors.

angles.text: As a night elf priest, you receive the Hallowed Sigil as your first summons to formal training under the Sisterhood of Elune.
As a Kaldorei devotee, the sigil marks the beginning of your service as Alliance travelers begin arriving on Teldrassil’s boughs.
